definitions.explanation: Lacking ability, talent, or competence. A harsh word used to describe someone who cannot perform their duties or role effectively. Carries strong negative connotation.

examples.japanese: {無能|むのう}な⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm troubled by an incompetent boss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無能|むのう}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛感|つうかん}→痛感：13614_tsuukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I keenly felt my own incompetence.

examples.japanese: {無能|むのう}な⟦{指導者|しどうしゃ}→指導者：03062_shidousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}った→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
examples.english: The country fell into chaos because of an incompetent leader.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Functions as a な-adjective: {無能|むのう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (an incompetent person). Also used as a noun: {無能|むのう}さ (incompetence), {無能|むのう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{嘆|なげ}く→嘆く：11814_nageku⟧ (to lament one's incompetence).

USAGE:
A strong, directly critical word. Using it about someone else is quite harsh, though it appears frequently in fiction and political criticism. When used about oneself, it expresses deep self-reproach. Combines ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) and ⟦{能|のう}→能：01927_nou⟧ (ability).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無能|むのう}な⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧: incompetent boss
- {無能|むのう}な⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧: incompetent politician
- {無能|むのう}さ: incompetence
- {無能|むのう}{呼|よ}ばわり: being called incompetent
